001package com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign;
002
003import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.JumpPointAPI.JumpDestination;
004import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketAPI;
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.characters.AbilityPlugin;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.characters.PersonAPI;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.EngagementResultAPI;
008
009/**
010 * 
011 * "Event" in the sense of something noteworthy happening, not just 
012 * actual "events" from events.json.
013 * 
014 * @author Alex Mosolov
015 *
016 * Copyright 2014 Fractal Softworks, LLC
017 */
018public interface CampaignEventListener {
019
020//      public static enum ListenerCategory {
021//              PLAYER,
022//              FLEET,
023//      }
024        
025        public static enum FleetDespawnReason {
026                /**
027                 * param is a SectorEntityToken
028                 */
029                REACHED_DESTINATION,
030                
031                /**
032                 * param is a BattleAPI, with a snapshot taken before the battle.
033                 */
034                DESTROYED_BY_BATTLE, 
035                NO_MEMBERS, // ??
036                OTHER,
037                NO_REASON_PROVIDED,
038                PLAYER_FAR_AWAY,
039        }
040        
041        void reportPlayerOpenedMarket(MarketAPI market);
042        void reportPlayerClosedMarket(MarketAPI market);
043        
044        void reportPlayerOpenedMarketAndCargoUpdated(MarketAPI market);
045        
046        void reportEncounterLootGenerated(FleetEncounterContextPlugin plugin, CargoAPI loot);
047        
048        void reportPlayerMarketTransaction(PlayerMarketTransaction transaction);
049        
050        
051        /**
052         * Once for each autoresolve round for AI vs AI. Only once per player battle encounter.
053         * @param primaryWinner
054         * @param battle
055         */
056        void reportBattleOccurred(CampaignFleetAPI primaryWinner, BattleAPI battle);
057        void reportBattleFinished(CampaignFleetAPI primaryWinner, BattleAPI battle);
058        
059        void reportPlayerEngagement(EngagementResultAPI result);
060        
061        /**
062         * Could be destroyed or simply reached a despawn location. Or had too many accidents
063         * and lost all of its ships. Or told by other code to despawn itself.
064         * @param fleet
065         * @param reason
066         * @param param
067         */
068        void reportFleetDespawned(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, FleetDespawnReason reason, Object param);
069        
070        
071        /**
072         * @param fleet
073         */
074        void reportFleetSpawned(CampaignFleetAPI fleet);
075        
076        /**
077         * Planets/stations/etc that are the target of a fleet's assignment.
078         * @param fleet
079         * @param entity
080         */
081        void reportFleetReachedEntity(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, SectorEntityToken entity);
082        
083        /**
084         * from is generally a JumpPointAPI, but doesn't *have* to be.
085         * @param fleet
086         * @param from
087         * @param to
088         */
089        void reportFleetJumped(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, SectorEntityToken from, JumpDestination to);
090        
091        
092        void reportShownInteractionDialog(InteractionDialogAPI dialog);
093        
094        
095        void reportPlayerReputationChange(String faction, float delta);
096        void reportPlayerReputationChange(PersonAPI person, float delta);
097        
098        void reportPlayerActivatedAbility(AbilityPlugin ability, Object param);
099        void reportPlayerDeactivatedAbility(AbilityPlugin ability, Object param);
100
101        
102        void reportPlayerDumpedCargo(CargoAPI cargo);
103        void reportPlayerDidNotTakeCargo(CargoAPI cargo);
104        
105        void reportEconomyTick(int iterIndex);
106        void reportEconomyMonthEnd();
107}
